title: Toy Story
plot: A cowboy toy doll feels jealous when a new space ranger toy arrives in the bedroom. The toys must work together to get home after they are lost at a gas station. Friendship between the toys grows.

title: Heat
plot: A professional thief plans one last bank robbery in Los Angeles. A driven police detective hunts the crew across the city. The heist ends in a violent shootout on crowded streets.

title: Postman, The (Postino, Il)
plot: A shy postman on a small Italian island delivers letters to an exiled poet. The poet teaches him about metaphors and poetry, and the postman uses verse to win the heart of a local woman.

title: Seven (a.k.a. Se7en)
plot: Two detectives hunt a serial killer who stages murders after the seven deadly sins. The dark rainy city hides the killer until a shocking twist in the desert reveals his final plan.

title: Alien
plot: The crew of a commercial space ship answers a distress signal on a distant planet. A deadly alien creature gets aboard and hunts the crew one by one through the dark corridors of the ship.

title: Aliens
plot: The survivor of the alien attack returns to the planet with a unit of space marines. The colony has gone silent and the marines face a nest of alien creatures and their queen in a desperate battle.

title: Alien³ (a.k.a. Alien 3)
plot: An escape pod crashes on a prison planet. The survivor discovers that an alien creature came with her and begins killing the prisoners. The inmates fight back with no weapons in the dark foundry.

title: Sabrina
plot: The daughter of a chauffeur returns from Paris transformed into an elegant woman. Two wealthy brothers fall for her and the romance tangles the family business and a planned merger.

title: Sabrina
plot: A remake about the chauffeur's daughter who comes back from Paris sophisticated and confident. A cold businessman brother pretends to court her to protect a merger and then falls in love.

title: Usual Suspects, The
plot: Five criminals meet in a police lineup and plan a heist together. A survivor tells the detective a twisting story about a mysterious crime lord. The final twist changes the meaning of everything.

title: Shrek
plot: A grumpy ogre living in a swamp sets out to rescue a princess from a dragon guarded castle. A talkative donkey joins the quest and the ogre discovers friendship and love along the way.

title: Avatar
plot: A paralysed marine is sent to a distant moon to join a mining program. Inside an alien avatar body he lives with the native clan, falls in love and leads the fight against the corporation.

title: Untitled Experiment
plot: An experimental film with no story in the usual sense. Images of the sea and the city alternate with silence, and the viewer is left to build a meaning from fragments and colours.

title: Lonely Film
plot: A lighthouse keeper spends a long winter alone on a rocky coast. Letters from his estranged daughter arrive by boat and slowly he decides to leave the island and repair the family bond.

title: Pulp Fiction
plot: Two hitmen, a boxer and a gangster's wife cross paths in Los Angeles. The stories are told out of order, full of dark comedy, violence and long conversations about everyday things.
